topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: The path my child must walk now crosses the ground I once did. The same guide stands at the fork, the one who shaped my steps. I see the echoes, the shadows of my own childhood in the air he breathes. It's a loop, a circle closing tighter. This should be a time for comfort, for the ease of familiarity. But the world doesn't sit still; the trails shift, the markers change. What was safe is not safe. The light dims, the silence grows. I watch, I wait, hoping the lessons learned will be enough, that the path he walks will lead to something more.
